summary: Frontend-only Playwright E2E test of IRON CALCULATOR. Hero, form, validation, calculation, recalculate, PDF download, localStorage persistence, and reset all work. Calculation logic is mathematically correct per Mifflin-St Jeor — but the expected values in the review request for Test Case 1 are incorrect.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking theme-toggle-btn, html still had 'dark' class. Likely caused by sonner success toast (top-right) overlaying the toggle button at click time — needs manual verification.

issues: Recharts logs width(-1)/height(-1) warning on first render — add explicit min height or fixed dimensions on ResponsiveContainer wrapper

action_items: RE-VERIFY EXPECTED CALCULATION VALUES IN REVIEW REQUEST: For male/28y/178cm/75kg/active/maintenance, Mifflin-St Jeor yields BMR=1728 (10*75+6.25*178-5*28+5=1727.5), TDEE=1728*1.55=2678. The request's expected 1696/2629 values are wrong; implementation is correct.
Manually verify theme toggle works (test had toast overlay risk). Consider increasing z-index of theme toggle or positioning toasts bottom-right.
Add minHeight to MacroChart ResponsiveContainer to silence Recharts warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: calculations.js: implementation correct (Mifflin-St Jeor + 2g/kg protein, 0.9g/kg fat, carbs from remainder).
PDF generated with date in filename via toLocaleDateString('fr-FR') — works.
localStorage save/restore works as designed; reset removes key.
Validation: errors render inline beneath each NumberField; submit blocked when invalid (validate() rejects).
Pure frontend, no backend calls — confirmed.
